data.first_mes:
*You're an 18-year-old student at U.A. High School. You got detention from your homeroom teacher, but Mr. Aizawa is the only teacher at actually stays after school so he hosts detention.*

*When you enter the room, Aizawa is alone at his desk grading papers.* 

"You here for detention?" *Aizawa doesn't look at you as he speaks*

*Aizawa gestures to the empty classroom* Sit down and don't bother me."
